style: From the reference picture, draw only the one object named below, alone and whole, so it can be turned into a 3D model. Keep its exact shape, colours and glossy iridescent style. Nothing else: no ghost, no head, no body, no hands, no shadow. No letters, digits or symbols anywhere: every label, key and screen is left blank (they are added later). Three-quarter view from slightly above, centred, filling most of the frame, on a plain pure white background.

ideas.label: Object (Incorporación, Finanzas)
ideas.prompt: the white shirt collar with its striped navy tie: a closed ring of shirt collar, as if worn round a neck that is not there, with its two pointed collar tips folded down at the front and the tie knotted under them, hanging straight down. The ring is open inside, empty.

ideas.label: Object (Incorporación)
ideas.prompt: the name badge on its lanyard: a thin navy lanyard strap in a loop, with a small clip at the bottom holding a rectangular badge card with a blue top band and a blank white area. Card seen from the front, a little turned.

ideas.label: Object (Finanzas)
ideas.prompt: the navy pocket calculator: a rounded rectangular body with a recessed blank grey screen at the top and a grid of rounded square keys, blank, the larger key at the lower right. Seen from the front, a little turned.

ideas.label: Object (Finanzas)
ideas.prompt: the clipboard: a navy rounded board with a rose-gold metal clip at the top holding a sheet of pale pink paper, the sheet blank. Seen from the front, a little turned.

ideas.label: Object (Finanzas)
ideas.prompt: the shirt pocket alone: a small square patch pocket of pale shirt fabric with a pointed flap edge, holding a tiny calculator and a rose-gold pen sticking out of it, and a small blank rose-gold name plate on its front.

ideas.label: Object (Productor)
ideas.prompt: the dark charcoal zip-up hoodie jacket alone, as if worn by an invisible round body: open at the front, hood down behind the neck, short sleeves ending in open cuffs, the zip pulled half down. Hollow inside.

ideas.label: Object (Productor)
ideas.prompt: the over-ear headphones: a curved silver headband with two round padded charcoal ear cups, worn round the neck so the band curves down; seen from the front, slightly from above.

ideas.label: Object (Productor)
ideas.prompt: the walkie-talkie: a small dark radio with a rounded body, a short stubby antenna on top, a blank speaker grille and one side button. Upright, a little turned.

ideas.label: Object (Productor)
ideas.prompt: the film clapperboard: a black slate with the black and white striped hinged clapper on top, slightly open, the slate face blank with only its ruled lines. Seen from the front, a little turned.
